args.query: California city crime rates violent crime homicide

sql: SELECT offense_code, "year", AVG(offense_rate) r, SUM(offense_rate) s, COUNT(*) n, AVG(population) p FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='CA' AND "year" IN ('2018','2019','2020','2023','2024','2025') GROUP BY offense_code, "year" ORDER BY offense_code, "year"

SELECT "year", SUM(CASE WHEN offense_code='violent-crime' THEN offense_rate END) v, SUM(CASE WHEN offense_code='homicide' THEN offense_rate END) h, SUM(CASE WHEN offense_code='property-crime' THEN offense_rate END) p FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='CA' AND "year" BETWEEN '2010' AND '2026' GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
